svg.title: ParkSure low-fidelity mobile wireframe set
svg.desc: Five black and white mobile wireframes: home dashboard, search and filter, place detail, user profile and settings.
svg.text: Dashboard / Home · Search & Filter · Item Detail · User Profile · Settings

g.text: Max stay 4 hrs · No overnight parking
Cancellation free up to 15 min before entry
No hidden fees · GST receipt on payment

svg.text: Greeting, search, map preview and nearby places.
Query, chips, list/map toggle and ranked results.
Hero, live price, bay availability and primary CTA.
Identity, vehicle, activity summary and account menu.
Grouped preferences, privacy, support and sign out.
Low-fidelity: layout, hierarchy and flow only. No brand colour, imagery or final copy.
